title: 第17章 突破第18章 迎亲
content_zh:
看着消失的李家人，萧玄策以及所有萧家之人欢呼雀跃，高兴大喊道“萧家无敌，萧天无敌……”
经过与李家这一战，也让萧家弟子看到了差距，毕竟现在萧家只有萧天是可以顶在前面的。
但是其他人确实差距厉害，而且也都知道，今天李来的几人还不是最强的。
所以，可想而知，这其中的差距。
当然，萧家除了现在的萧天也还有萧天的姐姐萧玉萱。
另一边，李乘风回到李家大院中，一直阴沉着脸。
虽然通过试探大致的了解了一下萧天的实力，但付出的代价却是有点大。
不仅仅是五百中品灵石那么简单，更重要的是受伤的两个弟子，伤势实在严重，最起码得需要两三个月的时间来恢复。
那么到时候宗门选拔就开始了。
这将直接影响他们的选拔结果。
这是李乘风风开口道“来人。”
话音刚落，李乘风身后出现一个黑衣人，半跪在地，说道“属下在”
李乘风阴狠的说道“加派人手，严密监控萧天。
一旦发现他单独走动，立马汇报。”
“属下领命”
随即黑衣人消失不见，好像从来没有出现过一样。
可见这人隐匿能力的强大。
李乘风喃喃自语道“这个萧天实力强大，一定要及时铲除，不然必成心腹大患……”
对比于李乘风的郁闷心情，萧玄策简直乐开了花，毕竟那么多年了都没能压李乘风一头。
难得让他吃瘪，自然是高兴无比。

随即对着众人道，“这次对于李家有备而来的挑衅，我们依然能压他们一头，萧天功不可没，按照刚刚说好的，这里的五百中品灵石就归萧天所有。”
萧天听到这也是诧异不已，毕竟不是小数目，所以他也没想着都要，于是想对着自己父亲道“家主……”
萧天话语刚出就被萧玄策打断了，开口道“这是你应该得的，是你保住了我们萧家颜面，你也是我们萧家崛起的力量，所以好好利用这样灵石。”
听到这话，萧天也不再推辞，对着萧玄策点点头。
看到萧天答应，萧玄策也是点点头，然后继续道“萧强也为我们萧家拼命，也是我们萧家的好儿郎，所以我额外奖励五十块中品灵石。”
听到萧玄策这话，每个人都非常的认可。
这就是萧玄策的高明的地方。
不仅仅把灵石给到了萧天，安慰了萧强，同时也提高了家族的凝聚力。
可谓是一举多得。
看到家族弟子的凝聚力再次提高，萧玄策也是异常的开心。
于是他趁此机会向众人公布道“三天后，萧天迎娶叶家小姐叶净心，这几天你们都好好准备！”
虽然之前就已经知道萧天要跟叶净心成婚。
但那是因为当时还不知道萧天已经可以修炼，而且实力还如此强大而做的决定。
现在情况不一样了，难道就不改变了！
众人也是有点疑惑。
但是既然家主已经发话，大家也是高声应道。
事后萧玄策找来了萧天，问道“你现在可以修炼了而且实力不错，有没有想过要悔婚？就算有我也是能理解，也支持，叶家那边你也不用担心。”
萧天笑着说道“我高兴还来不及呢！
怎么会悔婚呢！
父亲您就放心吧。

如果我不愿意的话，我就不会去见叶净心了。
content_en:
Seeing the disappearing Li family, Xiao Xuance and all the Xiao family members cheered and shouted happily, "The Xiao family is invincible, Xiao Tian is invincible..."
After this battle with the Li family, the Xiao family disciples also saw the gap. After all, only Xiao Tian can stand in front of the Xiao family.
But the gap between the others is indeed huge, and everyone knows that the few people Li came to today are not the strongest.
So, one can imagine the difference.
Of course, in addition to the current Xiao Tian, ​​the Xiao family also has Xiao Tian's sister Xiao Yuxuan.
On the other side, Li Chengfeng returned to the Li family compound, his face gloomy all the time.
Although he had a rough idea of ​​Xiao Tian's strength through testing, the price he paid was a bit high.
Not only was it as simple as five hundred middle-grade spiritual stones, but more importantly, the injuries to the two injured disciples were so serious that it would take at least two or three months to recover.
Then the sect selection will begin.
This will directly affect their selection results.
This is when Li Chengfeng said, "Here comes someone."
As soon as he finished speaking, a man in black appeared behind Li Chengfeng, half-kneeling on the ground, and said, "My subordinate is here."
Li Chengfeng said viciously, "Send extra manpower to monitor Xiao Tian closely.
If you find him walking alone, report him immediately. "
"Subordinates take orders"
Then the man in black disappeared, as if he had never appeared.
This shows how powerful this person's hiding ability is.
Li Chengfeng murmured to himself, "This Xiao Tian is very powerful and must be eradicated in time, otherwise he will become a serious trouble..."
Compared to Li Chengfeng's depressed mood, Xiao Xuance was simply happy. After all, he had not been able to beat Li Chengfeng for so many years.
It was rare for him to feel defeated, so naturally he was extremely happy.
Then he said to everyone, "This time, despite the well-prepared provocation from the Li family, we were still able to defeat them. Xiao Tian's contribution is indispensable. According to what was just agreed, the five hundred middle-grade spiritual stones here will belong to Xiao Tian."
Xiao Tian was surprised when he heard this. After all, it was not a small amount, so he didn't think about taking it all, so he wanted to say to his father, "Master..."
Xiao Tian was interrupted by Xiao Xuance as soon as he spoke, and said, "You deserve this. It is you who saved the face of our Xiao family. You are also the strength of our Xiao family's rise, so make good use of this spiritual stone."
Hearing this, Xiao Tian no longer refused and nodded to Xiao Xuance.
Seeing Xiao Tian agreeing, Xiao Xuance also nodded, and then continued, "Xiao Qiang also worked hard for our Xiao family and is also a good son of our Xiao family, so I will reward an additional fifty pieces of middle-grade spiritual stones."
Hearing Xiao Xuance's words, everyone agreed very much.
This is the brilliance of Xiao Xuance.
Not only did the spirit stone be given to Xiao Tian to comfort Xiao Qiang, but it also improved the cohesion of the family.
It can be said that it achieves multiple things with one stone.
Seeing that the cohesion of the family disciples has improved again, Xiao Xuance is also extremely happy.
So he took this opportunity to announce to everyone, "In three days, Xiao Tian will marry Miss Ye Jingxin of the Ye family. You should prepare well these days!"
Although I already knew that Xiao Tian was going to marry Ye Jingxin.
But that was a decision made because he didn't know at that time that Xiao Tian could already practice and was so powerful.
The situation is different now, won’t it change?
Everyone was also a little confused.
But since the head of the family has spoken, everyone responded loudly.
Afterwards, Xiao Xuance came to Xiao Tian and asked, "Now that you can practice and your strength is good, have you ever thought about regretting your marriage? Even if you have me, I can understand and support it. You don't have to worry about the Ye family."
Xiao Tian smiled and said, "It's not too late for me to be happy!
How could you regret your marriage?
Father, don't worry.
If I didn't want to, I wouldn't go to see Ye Jingxin.
